subject: general
question: Pipes A and B can empty a full tank in 16 hours and 24 hours, respectively. Pipe C alone can fill the empty tank in 4 hours. If A, B and C are opened together, the tank will be 35% full after :
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A can empty the tank in 16 hours

Pipe B can empty the tank in 24 hours

Pipe C can fill the tank in 4 hours

**Concept used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Efficiency ∝ 1/Time

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f13f54a04fcb0003180e197b47da0b90dbfcbc2b33d1c225f7696ab72dd322a.png] 

Efficiency of A = -3units/hr

Efficiency of B = -2 units/ hr

Efficiency of C = 12 units/hr

Here negative sign indicates the emptying nature of the pipes.

Total work = 48 units

35% of work = (35/100) × 48 = 16.8 units

Time to fill the tank by A, B, and C together = 16.8/(12 - 3 - 2)

⇒ 16.8/7 = 12/5

⇒ 2(2)/(5) hrs

**∴ A, B, C together will fill the tank in 2(2)/(5) hrs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** A's efficiency = 1/16

B's efficiency = 1/24

C's efficiency = 1/4

Total efficiency = 1/4 - 1/24 - 1/16 (pipes A and B are the emptying the tank Hence their efficiency is taken negatively here)

⇒ (12 - 3 - 2)/48 = 7/48

The time taken to fill the 100% tank = 48/7 hrs

Time taken to fill 35% of the tank = 48× 35/(7 × 100) 

⇒ 12/5 hrs 

⇒ 2(2)/(5) hrs

**∴ A, B, C together will fill the tank in 2(2)/(5) hrs.**
